import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd(); fig, ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5)); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off'); ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,6)
# ground
ax.plot([0,10],[0.5,0.5],'k-',lw=2); ax.text(0.2,0.2,'ground')
# wheels
import matplotlib.patches as mp
for x in [2,7]:
  c=plt.Circle((x,1.2),0.7,fill=False,lw=2); ax.add_patch(c); ax.text(x-0.3,1.1,'wheel')
# frame
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((1.5,1.9,6.2,0.3),fill=False,lw=2)); ax.text(3.5,2.25,'tube frame 0.95m')

ax.plot([1.5,7.7],[1.9,1.9],'k-',lw=3); ax.text(3.5,1.65,'belly pan')
# hopper stowed dashed + raised
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((3,2.3,3.2,1.0),fill=False,lw=2,linestyle='--')); ax.text(3.1,3.4,'hopper stowed')
# raised hopper tilted
import numpy as np
ax.plot([6.2,6.8,5.2,4.6,6.2],[2.5,4.2,4.5,2.8,2.5],'r-',lw=2); ax.text(5.0,4.6,'hopper raised',color='r')
# actuator
ax.plot([4.0,5.0],[2.2,3.2],'b-',lw=2); ax.text(3.2,2.8,'linear actuator',color='b')
# bin
ax.add_patch(mp.Rectangle((7.8,0.5,1.5,2.5),fill=False,lw=2)); ax.text(7.9,3.2,'bin 1m lip')
ax.plot([6.8,7.8],[4.0,3.1],'r--',lw=1); ax.text(6.9,3.7,'flow',color='r')
